page_title: MNT 1-3 REI | Montpellier v Reims 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but Yehvann Diouf punches the ball away.
90+4' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' William Still decides to make a substitution. Josh Wilson-Esbrand will be replaced by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
89' Substitution. Oumar Diakite walks off the pitch and Reda Khadra (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
88' Good chance! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Ferri will be replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
86' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
83' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
79' Junya Ito (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' The game has come to an end for Arnaud Nordin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
74' A substitution has been made. Joris Chotard goes off and Leo Leroy (Montpellier) comes on.
73' William Still has decided to make a change. Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) replaces Teddy Teuma.
72' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Thomas Foket (Reims) for his blatant foul.
71' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
70' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:5.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
67' The ball is cleared after Teji Savanier (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' The substitution has been made. Mohamed Daramy (Reims) has replaced Keito Nakamura.

64' Oumar Diakite (Reims) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Benjamin Lecomte anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
64' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joris Chotard (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Joris Chotard (Montpellier) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. PENALTY to Reims! Let's see who will take responsibility.
62' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) unleashes a mid-range direct free kick, but sees his strike well saved by the goalkeeper.
59' It will be a substitution. Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is ready to enter the pitch as Christopher Jullien walks off.
56' 1 - 3 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Teddy Teuma (Reims) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:3.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.
53' A cross into the box from Keito Nakamura (Reims) is cleared.
52' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
52' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the left post.
48' Keito Nakamura (Reims) commits a rough foul. Marc Bollengier stops the game and makes a call.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' 1 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top right corner and makes it 1:2. Yehvann Diouf was helpless.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' The Montpellier players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' 0 - 2 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Teddy Teuma (Reims) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Benjamin Lecomte stranded. 0:2.
39' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
38' Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
37' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marc Bollengier saw the whole situation.
35' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' A short pass finds Teji Savanier (Montpellier) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
28' What an opportunity! Oumar Diakite (Reims) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
26' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Azor Matusiwa (Reims), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
23' Junya Ito (Reims) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
18' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Teddy Teuma (Reims).

17' The game is interrupted. Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Reims win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
14' The percentage of ball possession is – 42:58.

8' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 0:1.
8' The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
8' Teddy Teuma (Reims) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Reims force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
6' The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.
3' Keito Nakamura (Reims) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
2' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Reims will take the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will referee today's match.
